title: NEB Class 12 Mathematics — Vector Algebra — 2024
subject: mathematics
source: NEB Grade 12 Model Questions / NEB Past Papers 2020-2024

questions.question: If a = i + 2j − k and b = 2i − j + 3k, find a·b, a × b and the angle between a and b.
questions.knowledgeNote: The dot product gives the angle; the cross product gives the perpendicular vector and the area — check magnitude |a×b| = √75 ≈ 8.66 = |a||b|sinθ.

questions.question: Find the projection of vector a = 2i + 3j + 2k on b = i + 2j + k, and state the condition for two vectors to be perpendicular.
questions.solution:
Projection of a on b = (a·b)/|b| = (2 + 6 + 2)/√(1 + 4 + 1) = 10/√6 ≈ **4.08** (the scalar projection).

(As a vector it is [(a·b)/|b|²]b = (10/6)(i + 2j + k).)

**Condition for perpendicularity:** a·b = 0 (the scalar product vanishes; for three dimensions this is the standard test since cos 90° = 0).
questions.knowledgeNote: The scalar projection is a signed length; the vector projection keeps the direction of b — examiners require the scalar unless the vector is asked.

questions.question: Find the area of the parallelogram whose adjacent sides are given by the vectors a = 3i + j − 2k and b = i − j + 4k.
questions.knowledgeNote: The triangle formed by the same two vectors has half this area — a common follow-up in the same question.
